title.narrative: Transitional phase to strengthen the rights and improve the living conditions of indigenous Twa in the Democratic Republic of Congo
Übergangsphase zur Stärkung der Rechte und Verbesserung der Lebenssituation autochthoner Twa in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo

description.narrative: Die Twa gehören zu den ältesten Völkern Zentralafrikas. The Twa are one of the oldest peoples in Central Africa. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, they can only exercise their rights to a limited extent and are subject to discrimination by the majority population, especially the Bantu. The impact of previous projects has fallen short of expectations, and the approaches raise fundamental questions because they do not provide a real solution to the exclusion, lack of access to resources, and threat to their cultural identity.
